inputThis: $:set -euo pipefail; name=$(gh codespace list --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --json name,repository --jq '.[]|select(.repository=="BestNameYet/Terminals")|.name' | head -n 1); test -n "$name"; state=$(gh api "user/codespaces/${name}" --jq .state); printf 'before_restore=%s\n' "$state"; if [ "$state" != Shutdown ]; then gh api --method POST "user/codespaces/${name}/stop" >/dev/null; fi; gh api "user/codespaces/${name}" --jq '"after_request="+.state'
